messages:
maria: Quick UX thread — proposing a 'Compact tool output' toggle in the Playground run panel. Screenshot attached. Idea: collapse tool headers/metadata to reduce noise for long tool chains. Link to mock: https://figma.internal/r/compact-playground (preview). Thoughts?

kevin: Nice. A11y flag — when collapsed the content still needs to be reachable by keyboard and screen readers. Toggle must expose aria-expanded and aria-controls.

ellie: Copy nit: 'Compact tool output' reads clearer than 'Compact output'. Also tooltip should say: 'Condenses tool blocks; expand to view details.'

sam: +1 for 'Condense tool output' copy. Tooltip suggestion: 'Reduces visual noise — expands to show full tool output.' Keeps intent clear for new users.

maria: Telemetry note: we should emit `playground.compact_toggle` with props: state (on/off), model, playground_route, session_id. Example: `analytics.track('playground.compact_toggle', {state: 'on'})`. Who owns the schema?

kevin: I'll add aria/focus details in the PR. For keyboard: when expanding, focus should move into the output container and a live region should announce 'Tool output expanded'. Quick code hint: `button.setAttribute('aria-controls', panelId); button.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true')`.

ellie: Run history interaction: if a user expands one run, optionally collapse others (tunable). Ensure this is still keyboard-accessible (use arrow keys + enter to expand). Also announce 'Output expanded' via SR-only live region.

sam: Small visual/accessibility nit: chevron contrast is low in the mock (meet 4.5:1?). If not, use token `icon-contrast-strong`.

maria: UX question — persist the compact preference per-user (console setting) or per-session? I'm leaning per-user stored in localStorage & account settings.

kevin: Per-user makes sense. Add fallback: if user hasn't set, default to workspace preference. Also include an admin toggle to disable compact globally for support debugging.

devex-bot: Preview build ready: https://staging.redwood.internal/playground/compact?pr=342 — includes toggle + analytics stub. :rocket:

ellie: I'm adding an a11y test plan to the ticket: 1) keyboard navigation 2) screenreader announcement 3) contrast checks 4) focus order 5) persistent preference test.

maria: Thanks everyone. I'll update Figma and open a small PR with the toggle, analytics hook, and copy change. Assigning: @kevin aria/focus, @ellie a11y QA, @sam copy. Will follow up with the PR link. :+1:
